scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test: node --test --experimental-strip-types src/**/*.test.mjs && pnpm run test:sops && pnpm run test:community && pnpm run test:ontology && pnpm run test:deliberation && pnpm run test:debate && pnpm run test:persona && pnpm run test:voice && pnpm run test:shared-workspaces && pnpm run test:scheduled-sources && pnpm run test:app-iterations && pnpm run test:source-security && pnpm run test:project-sources
scripts.test:app-iterations: pnpm exec esbuild ./src/routes/venom-app-iterations.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=./dist/venom-app-iterations.integration.test.cjs && NODE_ENV=test LOG_LEVEL=silent node --test ./dist/venom-app-iterations.integration.test.cjs
scripts.test:voice: pnpm exec esbuild ./src/lib/venom-voice-restraint.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/venom-voice-restraint.test.mjs && node --test /tmp/venom-voice-restraint.test.mjs && pnpm exec esbuild ./src/routes/venom-voice.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=/tmp/venom-voice.test.cjs && node --test /tmp/venom-voice.test.cjs && pnpm exec esbuild ./src/lib/venom-voice-decision-retention.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:pino-pretty --outfile=/tmp/venom-voice-decision-retention.integration.test.cjs && NODE_ENV=production node --test /tmp/venom-voice-decision-retention.integration.test.cjs
scripts.test:persona: pnpm exec esbuild ./src/lib/venom-persona.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/venom-persona.test.mjs && node --test /tmp/venom-persona.test.mjs && pnpm exec esbuild ./src/routes/venom-host-profile.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=/tmp/venom-host-profile.integration.test.cjs && NODE_ENV=test node --test /tmp/venom-host-profile.integration.test.cjs
scripts.test:ontology: pnpm exec esbuild ./src/lib/venom-ontology-core.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/venom-ontology-core.test.mjs && node --test /tmp/venom-ontology-core.test.mjs && pnpm exec esbuild ./src/routes/venom-ontology.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=/tmp/venom-ontology.integration.test.cjs && NODE_ENV=test node --test /tmp/venom-ontology.integration.test.cjs && pnpm exec esbuild ./src/lib/venom-identity.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=/tmp/venom-identity.integration.test.cjs && NODE_ENV=test node --test /tmp/venom-identity.integration.test.cjs
scripts.test:sops: esbuild ./src/lib/sop-content-safety.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=./dist/sop-content-safety.test.mjs && node --test ./dist/sop-content-safety.test.mjs && esbuild ./src/lib/sop-context.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=./dist/sop-context.test.mjs && node --test ./dist/sop-context.test.mjs && esbuild ./src/routes/venom-sops.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=./dist/venom-sops.integration.test.cjs && NODE_ENV=test node --test ./dist/venom-sops.integration.test.cjs
scripts.test:community: rm -rf /tmp/venom-community-tests && mkdir -p /tmp/venom-community-tests && for file in src/lib/community-agenda.test.ts src/lib/community-cursor.test.ts src/lib/community-rate-limit.test.ts src/routes/venom-community-summarize.test.ts src/routes/venom-community-notifications.test.ts; do name=$(basename "$file" .ts); pnpm exec esbuild "$file" --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile="/tmp/venom-community-tests/$name.mjs" || exit 1; done && node --test /tmp/venom-community-tests/*.mjs
scripts.test:source-security: pnpm exec esbuild ./src/lib/website-safety.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/venom-website-safety.test.mjs && node --test /tmp/venom-website-safety.test.mjs && pnpm exec esbuild ./src/lib/source-membership.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/venom-source-membership.test.mjs && node --test /tmp/venom-source-membership.test.mjs && pnpm exec esbuild ./src/lib/source-citations.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/venom-source-citations.test.mjs && node --test /tmp/venom-source-citations.test.mjs && pnpm exec esbuild ./src/lib/source-attestations.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/venom-source-attestations.test.mjs && node --test /tmp/venom-source-attestations.test.mjs && pnpm exec esbuild ./src/lib/portfolio-zip.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/venom-portfolio-zip.test.mjs && node --test /tmp/venom-portfolio-zip.test.mjs
scripts.test:build-packages: pnpm exec esbuild ./src/lib/venom-build-package-generator.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/venom-build-package-generator.test.mjs && node --test /tmp/venom-build-package-generator.test.mjs && pnpm exec esbuild ./src/routes/venom-build-runs.integration.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=/tmp/venom-build-runs.integration.test.cjs && NODE_ENV=production node --test /tmp/venom-build-runs.integration.test.cjs
scripts.smoke:venom-providers:strict: pnpm exec esbuild ./src/lib/venom-provider-smoke.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/venom-provider-smoke.mjs && VENOM_PROVIDER_SMOKE_RUN=1 VENOM_PROVIDER_SMOKE_REQUIRE_ALL=1 node /tmp/venom-provider-smoke.mjs
